text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've had a headache since this morning. I
didn't
realize how hard I've been pushing
myself...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I read somewhere that headaches are a
result of disruptions in one's daily life,
but I've been
exercising and sleeping as
usual, so why?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's a nutritional issue. What have
I eaten
in the past few days?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Just trying to remember is making
the pain worse... It's like that age-old
question, which
came first, the carrot or
the hunger?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O continues to suffer
from her
headache of unknown origin for
some time.
